notes: The endpoint uses multipart/form-data encoding, not JSON
All three files are required in each request
The specimen_signatures file should contain exactly 3 visible signatures
Signature detection uses contour detection with area and aspect ratio filtering
Features are extracted using OpenCV HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) and histogram features
Similarity is calculated using cosine similarity between feature vectors
No external API calls are made - all processing is done locally with OpenCV
